description_en: Invokes the API to query the logs of a scene orchestration interaction rule
description_zh: 调用该接口查询场景联动规则日志
name: QuerySummarySceneRuleLog

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You do not need to specify this parameter for public instances. You must specify this parameter for an Enterprise instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scene orchestration interaction rule. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169498.html operation to obtain the ID of the scene orchestration interaction rule
parameters.help_zh: 场景联动规则ID。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169498.html接口获取场景联动规则ID
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the scene orchestration interaction rule logs. Specify a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

You can query the logs generated when you execute the rule within the last 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
场景联动规则日志的开始时间，单位为秒，输入Unix时间戳。

最多可查询近一个月（30天）的规则执行日志
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the scene orchestration interaction rule logs. Specify a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

You can query the logs generated when you execute the rule within the last 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
场景联动规则日志的结束时间，单位为秒，输入Unix时间戳。

最多可查询近一个月（30天）的规则执行日志
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The result when you execute the scene orchestration interaction rule. Valid values:

0: The execution failed.

1: The execution succeeded
parameters.help_zh:
场景联动规则的执行结果。

0：表示失败。

1：表示成功
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 30. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大取值30，最小取值1，默认取值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1
parameters.name: current_page

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates that the call is successful. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量

Total.description_en: The total number of scene orchestration interaction rule logs
Total.description_zh: 场景联动规则日志总数量

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
